method: Each state is reproduced deterministically (harness URL = archetype + seed + species [+ scenario]; Challenge runs with a seeded Math.random and a fixed launch seed) and captured paused. Engine truth comes from adapter.region(i) (condition factors f; blocked = f < config.categories.blockedBelow), sim.derived() tolerances and adapter.previewOf for every offered trait. Answers use the rules in `rules`.

rules.q1_trueCause: the banner's named limiting category equals the lowest-f category AND, for Soil / Hazard, the hint's named fix targets the real sub-cause (salt vs pH, radiation vs toxicity); 'partial' when several factors fail and the named fix alone does not open the region (hint traits' previews do not open it)
rules.q2_symptomVsRoot: 'yes' when the banner (or the scenario card shown with it) names the mechanism behind the symptom (decline / native / shock / water barrier / refuge / Biomass); 'room-only' when only Region Inspect says it; 'no' otherwise
rules.q3_helpfulAction: 'yes' when a 'Would help' suggestion truly opens the region (previewOf gain) and can be bought now or shows its price; 'improves-only' when the only true effect is 'better'; 'no' when no visible action would help, 'misleading' when a visible suggestion does not help
rules.q4_nextStepInferable: heuristic: yes = q1 yes and q3 yes; partial = one of them; no = neither — HUMAN PLAYTEST NEEDED for the real answer
rules.q5_collisions: computed across all states: two mechanics sharing an icon or a status word, or the same text colour for different meanings
